evidence.note: Tarshish is the second name under the heading “sons of Javan.”

name: תַּרְשִׁישׁ
note: The place and personal-name records share the spelling.
summary: Three people bear the name Tarshish, including a son of Javan in Genesis 10:4. Tarshish also names a place associated with seagoing ships in Psalm 48:8.
